sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Requirements for Oklahoma Drivers

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
Registration buys the tag or sticker proving taxes paid, while title transfer proves ownership changes hands at sale [A01].
Why it matters: group registration-vs-title; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
Twenty-five thousand dollars opens bodily coverage, fifty thousand covers multi-victim crashes, twenty-five thousand covers property, and every figure counts per accident [A01].
Why it matters: group minimums; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A01
Officers, Service Oklahoma staff, and fellow crash parties all rate a look at your proof, and you copy their details in return [A01].
Why it matters: group proof-display; difficulty low; prereq sec03-F02; confusables sec03-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A01
Uninsured crashes with injury or five-hundred-dollar damage suspend the license directly, while no-proof tickets suspend license plus tags through court notice [A01].
Why it matters: group insurance-suspensions; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F02; confusables sec03-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A01
Manufacturing a fake form is a felony, while merely possessing one is a misdemeanor pairing two hundred fifty dollars with mandatory suspension [A01].
Why it matters: group fake-forms; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A01
Mail follows the address of record only, so stale records can suspend you in ignorance [A01].
Why it matters: group address-record; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A02
Belts soften impact, pin riders inside and in command, and spare buckled passengers from forward flight [A02].
Why it matters: group belt-physics; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A02
Rear-facing holds until age two or maker caps, under-eight means restrained, and four-to-eight at or under four-nine takes a restraint or a belt [A02].
Why it matters: group child-restraint; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec03-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A02
No adult grip can save an unrestrained infant from windshield flight, and standing or floorboard riding invites skull injury [A02].
Why it matters: group child-danger; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F09; confusables sec03-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A02
Airbags threaten sub-five-foot riders, under-twelves ride aft, and the back seat beats the front by twenty-six percent [A02].
Why it matters: group seating-safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0017]
